reviews.text: I cannot say enough wonderful things about Mr. Bodhi ! Everyone who works there is so incredibly sweet, loving, and caring. You can genuinely tell how much they adore dogs, and they treat my girl like absolute royalty every single time. We come in for full-service grooming, and she always leaves looking and smelling fantastic, and less shedding (plus, they send her home in the cutest fancy necklaces!). On top of the amazing care, their prices are reasonable and the staff is always welcoming and friendly.
Nilo was fantastic!
High quality pet grooming, friendly and excellent service.
Our Microbernadoodle entered Mr. Bodhi's looking pathetic. Stella worked her magic and turned out dog Piper into a movie star! Thank you so much.

I have been taking my dog Archie to Mr Bodhi’s for about 6 months now. I can’t tell you what a great job they do grooming my dog and also with their communications during the groom (I love the 30 minute heads-up that he is almost done). The owners are so wonderful and Stella does such a great job with Archie who can be nervous when I leave him. I get him the full groom and it includes everything you’d want. They even give you a loyalty discount every time which I so appreciate. Highly recommend Mr Bodhi’s for your grooming needs!
Great place for a quick DIY bath. Staff is super friendly and you can tell they really love dogs! good selection of high-quality treats as well

Brought my standard poodle here because our usual groomer closed due to an emergency, couldn't be happier with the service we received! Nina and Nilo were very kind and professional, and they took excellent care of my pooch! The store itself is also great; everything is clean and organized, fairly priced, and their artwork and decorations are super cute! Highly recommend this business to everyone :)
Great self wash station with friendly employees.

Sweet Nina is as genuine as they come. She’s deeply knowledgeable, has a heart of pure gold, and is one of the kindest souls you’ll ever meet. Her true love for animals shines through in all that she does.

Nina and her staff did an amazing job grooming our Gretzky. As a German Shepherd, he has isn’t the easiest dog to groom but she did an incredible job with the deshedding process. She puts 100% into her service and the high quality shows!
Love Bodhis !!
Love this place! Walkable from Del Mar dog beach, they are always super friendly, and their self wash setup is top notch!
Great place for a pet scub
The staff was very friendly and our dog was treated very well. So soft and fluffy and smelling great!
Here, the puppies are treated with respect and dignity. In a healthy environment. The best so far
Great service!! Thank you!!
Thank you for your review. We appreciate your feedback and hope to improve your experience in the future.
Love this place, always clean and super nice staff, dog comes back smelling good and well groomed.

I have been beinging my golden retriever to Mr. Bodhi's for the last two years.  The salon is very clean and surprisingly quiet compared to other pet salons I have frequented over the years.  Nina is very friendly and professional and takes great care of my dog.  My dog is white and gets very dirty and yellow---she gets him sparkling!  Also, he is very nervous around loud noises (like the blow dryer) and she knows how to keep him calm.  It was our lucky day when we found Mr. Bodhi's!
Fantastic spot for grooming and pet treats.

Mr.Bodhi's is the best grooming and pet store in North County and Solana Beach. This was a vision that Nina, Rob and Mr. Bodhi had and they made it happen.  Nina was my pet sitter before the store was opened. Nina and staff always take great care of the boys and treats them as their  own. The boys love taking their daily walks to Mr.Bodhi's and they adore the store. It is important to find a store that truly cares about their customers and furry friends.  I love that you can book online grooming appointments to meet your scheduling needs and all the groomers are fantastic. Nina is an expert on dog nutrition, health and grooming . Nina  also provides good sound advice. She really played a crucial role in helping extend the life of my dog that was diagnosed with cancer 2 years ago. I believe by taking her advice and education by placing him on an all keto diet helped slow the cancer and was a game changer. He is a very happy dog and enjoys his treats and food from Mr.Bodhi's. He still takes his short walks to Mr. Bodhi's and his eyes light up when he sees Nina. I believe Mr. Bodhi's and my great vet at Del Norte Animal Hospital really helped extend his life and he just keeps proving the books wrong. He just turned 14 years and 6 months. All I can do is say thank you to Mr.Bodhi's. I think it is important to support out local business in Solana Beach. The store can special order treats and foods that meets your dogs or cats need. Keep up the great work!
Great dog grooming spot in Solana Beach.  We take our poodle and Labrador there.  Friendly staff and easy parkingz
What a gem Mr Bodhi's is!  Nina and staff are great, dogs don't mind being there in the cage free grooming area.  Lots of love given, dirty dogs come home clean with great haircuts and trims.

Thank you so much for the wonderful review, Rosemary! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience at Mr. Bodhi's Grub & Scrub. Your kind words mean a lot to us and motivate our team to continue providing top-notch service. We look forward to seeing you and your furry friend again soon!
Nina takes such care with my Frenchie. I wouldn’t bring him anywhere else!
They did an awesome job with my two pups!
Best first time experience ever!

We love taking our dog, Larry, to Mr. Bodi‘s grub and scrub. They do an amazing job with his grooming, and his baths. He is a golden doodle, so we know it takes a lot of work. Staff has always been very friendly, and I know that Larry is well taken care of during his time there.  We highly recommend and tell all of our friends to go!!
Great service. Nina is the best!
